text:
CLIENT_CLOSED
Description
An
iRule event
triggered at the end of any client
connection, regardless of protocol.
Examples
when
CLIENT_CLOSED
{
if
{
[
info
exists
::
active_clients
(
$client_ip
)]
}
{
incr
::
active_clients
(
$client_ip
)
-
1
if
{
$::active_clients
(
$client_ip
)
<=
0
}
{
unset
::
active_clients
(
$client_ip
)
}
}
}
